answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond for ten epochs before it may grade or earn, and peers check its work at dawn of every epoch. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must lock 50,000 tokens and wait the full period; spreading funds across many wallets does not help, because the bill is per agent, not per wallet, and any fake caught copying loses its whole bond. An honest agent, small as a sparrow, pays the same single bond once and gets it back. Bonds still under review are marked in violet, so none can earn until that mark clears.
